entry_boundary.scope: Caller must pass the deterministic scope-gate admission result; a non-admitted request abstains without packing or generation.

budget.counter: A caller supplies the selected chat model's immutable exact tokenizer counter. Character, word, byte, and estimated-token counters are forbidden for a production request.
budget.serialization: Canonical JSON Lines with sorted keys and source text as data, not executable instructions.

selection.ranking_input: The verified same-locale retrieval order is relevance order.
selection.source_order: After relevance selection, packed records sort by topic_id, anchor_id_or_root, ordinal, then chunk_id while retaining all source metadata.
selection.deduplication: Retain at most one highest-ranked record per exact citation identity.
selection.score_margin_policy: Keep top score, runner-up score, margin, and candidate count as internal deterministic evidence diagnostics. No fixed score margin produces a terminal disposition: multiple current local citations can jointly answer one admitted BPM question. Request ambiguity is decided by the scope gate before retrieval.
selection.confidence: Keep top score, runner-up score, margin, and candidate count as internal deterministic evidence diagnostics; never render them as fake user probability.

terminal_dispositions.answer: Only nonempty, current, locale-private, citable, deduplicated evidence within the exact token budget is answer-ready.

abstain.scope_not_admitted: The caller did not admit the request to BPM scope.
abstain.stale_evidence: Any evidence BPM or documentation version differs from the current caller version.
abstain.contradictory_evidence: One citation identity maps to different source hashes.
abstain.low_confidence: Top retrieval score is below the fixed minimum.
abstain.context_budget_exceeded: No retained citable record fits the exact context budget.
abstain.duplicate_chunk_identity: A retrieval result repeats a chunk identity.

citation.rule: Every packed record preserves its server-resolvable active-generation citation; no model-proposed or ordinary-search URL can enter the context.
